newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel, PSA to develop Singapore sites.
newsitem.headline: Keppel, PSA to develop Singapore sites.

text.p: The Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) and Keppel Corp Ltd said on Monday they would develop jointly sites totalling 52.3 hectares in western Singapore.

The sites to be developed comprise 32 hectares of prime waterfront land, including Pulau Keppel belonging to Keppel, and 20.3 hectares of mixed use development located at the Maritime Square, PSA and Keppel said in a joint statement.
Maritime Square encompasses the World Trade Centre, Cable Car Towers, Singapore Cruise Centre, Expo Halls and carparks.
The area will become a hub for maritime-related business and leisure activities.
Keppel has obtained outline planning approval to develop its site into a waterfront condominium with marina facilities and an office park.
When completed, Keppel's project will yield a total gross floor area of about 435,000 square metres.
This is higher than the original development density when the plan was conceived in 1992, resulting in a higher plot ratio of 1.4.
Keppel Land has been appointed development manager for the project.
No further details were immediately available.
